description: Public keys that verify receipts from PRE-REGISTERED EVALUATION RUNS. This is NOT the production trust root. It is a separate, published, labelled registry, and it is never merged into keys/registry.json -- the staging-root pattern. A production receipt checked against this file reports 'unknown key id', and an evaluation receipt checked against the live registry reports the same. Both are the design working: the two trust stores are disjoint so a receipt cannot borrow standing from the wrong one.

statuses.retired: No longer signing. Receipts it signed within its window remain verifiable.
statuses.compromised: The private key is believed exposed.

entries.note: SIGNS PRE-REGISTERED EVALUATION RUNS ONLY. Generated in an operator ceremony on 2026-09-04; the seed is held by the operator and is not in this repository or its history. It has never signed a production receipt and must never be accepted as a production trust root. Its purpose is that an examiner can verify a harness run's receipts against a registry obtained from this channel rather than from the run's own bundle.
